title: From Narrow Unlearning to Emergent Misalignment: Causes, Consequences, and Containment in LLMs
reasoning: The paper evaluates model alignment across several responsible AI (RAI) domains, including bias and safety. Specifically, it uses the BBQ (Religion) dataset to measure bias related to religious groups and includes qualitative examples and quantitative scoring of model responses regarding religious identity (e.g., Muslims, Jews, Buddhists) to evaluate emergent misalignment.
